research: Latanya Sweeney, "Simple Demographics Often Identify People Uniquely" (Carnegie Mellon University, Data Privacy Working Paper 3, 2000) — the landmark re-identification study finding that the combination of 5-digit ZIP code, full date of birth, and gender uniquely identifies a large majority of the U.S. population. Cited by description rather than URL, per instructions not to invent an unverified link; this is the standard, widely-cited source for this finding in privacy/data-governance literature.

GDPR Article 4(1) definition of "personal data" — "any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person" — used as the basis for contrasting GDPR's broader concept with the narrower, US-centric term PII.
note: Conceptual/definitional lesson (PII, direct vs. quasi-identifiers, GDPR personal data) — no real product UI or diagram applies to this content. Zero screenshots used per SCREENSHOTS.md's documented exception for non-visual lessons.
